info.title: Programmable Custom Launch API V3 general hook profile
info.summary: General project-owned Uniswap v4 hook graph request contract.
info.description: This document publishes revision 3 of programmable.direct-native-hook-graph.v1. Metadata-bound profile 3.2.0 is current; exact profiles 3.1.0 and 3.0.0 remain readable and retryable under their original immutable metadata-absent policies. The current profile accepts project-owned tokens, project-owned hooks, all valid Uniswap v4 permission masks and three to sixteen exact direct graph targets. Every target is rebuilt with solc 0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a from exact Standard JSON and materialized runtime bytes. A platform-issued admission receipt binds the exact graph, role-aware static classification and Router simulation boundary before wallet authorization. These checks are not an audit, honeypot guarantee, liquidity or tradeability guarantee, or fee-behavior certification. Funding may be absent, carried as exact native Router transaction value, or use a separate EIP-3009 wallet signature. No API key can sign or broadcast a wallet transaction. Revision 2 requests also remain readable and retryable with their original exact bytes.

get.summary: Discover the public V3 capability boundary
get.description: Unauthenticated, non-authorizing discovery for the current V3 profile, exact routes, structural graph support, funding and liquidity modes, evidence tiers and negative guarantees. Capability discovery does not prove that a submitted project is deployable, routable, indexed, source verified or featured.

get.summary: List finalized public Custom launch metadata
get.description: Unauthenticated bounded newest-first feed of finalized Router identities and their launch-id-bound project metadata. It contains no API key, controller-private request bytes, pending request or wallet action. Consumers must key identity by routerLaunchId, never resourceId. A 503 has no embedded last-known-good payload; downstream indexers may maintain their own bounded LKG with explicit freshness.

Cache-Control.description: Short public cache with bounded stale revalidation.

post.summary: Evaluate the exact V3 request without creating a launch
post.description: Run the production profile parser, exact source/build binding and deterministic static baseline against the same byte-identical V3 body later used by create. Preflight consumes no launch quota, allocates no nonce, persists no launch and never signs or broadcasts. Its deployable, routable and featured booleans are distinct eligibility axes at the reported evidence tier; they are not deployment, trading, source-verification, indexing or feature-placement proof and are never a safety guarantee.

requestBody.description: The exact locally validated programmable.custom-launch-create-request.v3 bytes. There is no wrapper and preflight never reserves the request nonce.

200.description: Side-effect-free V3 preflight classification for the exact request hash.

post.summary: Submit an exact V3 general-hook request
post.description: Submit the byte-identical CLI-derived request. Every target remains per-launch bound to exact source, compiler, build, creation/runtime bytes, final calldata and simulation evidence. Role-aware blocking indicators stop before wallet authorization; bound warnings remain visible and continue to exact Router simulation. Admission is not an audit or a safety, liquidity, tradeability, honeypot, or fee-behavior guarantee.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Exact-request idempotency binding. It must not contain an API key or wallet signature.

200.description: An exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the existing V3 resource.

202.description: A new request is durably accepted for exact validation and conformance processing.

503.description: A transient dependency is unavailable. Honor Retry-After and retry only the byte-identical request; never fall back to another create version.

error.message: A required production dependency is temporarily unavailable

get.description: Version-matched newest-first wallet-owned list. Pending rows may receive bounded best-effort reconciliation; use single-resource GET for precise polling.

The single-resource contract is the precise polling source for conformance state, any exact funding challenge and, after validation and simulation, the exact Router transaction. The API never signs or broadcasts either wallet action.

404.description: Launch not found for this wallet principal.

post.summary: Submit one explicitly wallet-signed EIP-3009 authorization
post.description: Website-BFF to backend handoff only; this is not an API-key CLI operation. The website must first authenticate the wallet principal, show and validate the exact challenge, request eth_signTypedData_v4 only after an explicit user action, verify the canonical signature client-side, and then submit it once with a durable Idempotency-Key. Acceptance does not send the separate Router transaction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Durably binds this exact signature body. An identical replay returns 200; body substitution under the same key returns 409.

parameters.name: X-Programmable-Privy-User-Id
parameters.description: Server-verified Privy principal. Browsers must not manufacture this header directly.

parameters.name: X-Programmable-Wallet-Address
parameters.description: Checksum wallet address already proven linked to the authenticated principal by the website BFF.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key and body replay; returns the existing full V3 resource without applying the signature twice.

202.description: First acceptance of the exact canonical signature. The resource advances through funding_authorization_verified and may return pending_review, action_required, prepared, simulating, or authorized; the Router transaction still requires a later explicit wallet send.

400.description: Malformed schema, signature, digest, launch binding, or Idempotency-Key.

403.description: The verified principal does not control the launch wallet.

404.description: Launch not found for this wallet principal.

409.description: Idempotency substitution, stale funding intent/digest, or a launch that already advanced under different authorization bytes.

RequestId.description: HTTP correlation identifier. Preserve it with the HTTP status and UTC time for support; it is not the durable launch resource requestId.

RetryAfter.description: Whole-second delay before the next safe retry.

CustomLaunchApiKey.description: Wallet-bound API key loaded from PROGRAMMABLE_API_KEY or the supported operating-system secret store. It is never accepted as an argument or prompt and grants no wallet signing authority.

CustomLaunchWebsiteToken.description: Server-to-server credential held only by the Programmable website BFF. A browser authenticates its own wallet session to the BFF and never receives this token.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, query values, Idempotency-Key, hash binding or closed V3 request shape.

Unauthorized.description: The required API key or website service credential is missing, malformed, expired, revoked or unknown.

Forbidden.description: The required scope, wallet binding or verified website principal is missing.

Conflict.description: The idempotency key, nonce, funding intent or durable launch state conflicts with the submitted bytes. Do not mutate a retry merely to bypass the conflict.

RequestTooLarge.description: The streaming request body exceeded 8,388,608 bytes.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Content-Type must be application/json, optionally with charset=utf-8.

Unprocessable.description: The request parsed but failed source, graph, hook-permission, admission, funding, profile or exact-simulation validation.

LaunchQuotaExceeded.description: The launch admission quota or wallet-admin rate limit was reached. Honor Retry-After before retrying identical bytes.

Retry-After.description: Delay before the next exact retry.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure. The response includes a correlation requestId and no secret.

V3Unavailable.description: A required V3 production dependency is temporarily unavailable.

error.message: A required production dependency is temporarily unavailable

graph.description: The project owns its primary token and primary hook. Three through sixteen exact direct targets are structurally supported.

hookPermissions.description: All fourteen Uniswap v4 hook permission bits are structurally accepted when address bits, dependencies and concrete reachable callback implementations match. This is not universal behavioral compatibility.

productTruthAxes.description: Independent product claims. Evidence for one axis never proves another.

CustomLaunchCapabilitiesV1.description: Public additive discovery for the current V3 structural and operational boundary. It grants no authorization and makes no universal, audit or safety claim.

deployable.description: The exact request cleared the bounded deployment-mechanics preflight at this evidence tier. This does not prove that a deployment happened.

routable.description: The exact request cleared the current routing-evidence preflight. This does not prove live trading, liquidity or economic safety.

featured.description: The exact request currently meets the preflight feature-eligibility policy. This does not prove indexing or placement.

riskClassification.description: Current revision-3 static classification. Revision-2 compatibility preflight returns null.

CustomLaunchPreflightV1.description: Side-effect-free classification of one exact V3 request. Risk classification, platform-owned behavior requirements and six independent product-truth axes are explicit. An unexecuted behavior vector is not a failure and never becomes a caller-declared pass. This response is not a durable launch resource, deployment proof, trading proof, audit, source-verification result, indexing result or feature-placement promise.

needsEvidenceFindingCodes.description: Conditions that require executable or governance evidence but do not categorically block current revision-3 admission.

PlatformAdmissionRiskClassificationV3.description: Deterministic static classification. deployable means only that no current revision-3 hard blocker matched; routable and featured remain false until separate evidence exists.

CustomLaunchBehaviorExecutionV3.description: Accepted only from a platform runtime executor and bound to the exact subject and requirement hashes. Caller or agent declarations never satisfy this schema.

CustomLaunchBehaviorEvidenceSummaryV3.description: Platform-owned runtime-evidence summary. not_executed means the vectors remain outstanding; it never means verified and cannot be supplied by the API caller.

CustomLaunchProductTruthAxesV3.description: Six independent product claims. A positive or eligible value on one axis never implies another axis.

CustomLaunchLifecycleQueueV3.description: Bounded durable-worker readback. Queue completion is not launch finality, and a retry does not change the durable launch status. Worker identity, payloads and raw errors are never exposed.

NonzeroCanonicalUint256.description: Nonzero base-10 uint256 with no sign or leading zeroes.

SelectedFeeHundredthsOfBipV1.description: Intent-bound selected fee from 0 through 999999 hundredths of a bip. In additive mode the effective total is selected+1000; in inclusive mode it is max(selected,1000).

tokenTargetId.description: Canonical selected token target identifier. Recognizable secret material is rejected because finalized metadata is public.

initializerTargetId.description: Must reference a direct graph target whose componentKind is other. Initializer is a role, not a component kind.

platformFeeBindingTargetId.description: May reference the hook or another exact direct graph target that implements the declared platform fee binding.

DirectNativeTargetRolesV1.description: The token, hook and initializer IDs are distinct. The platform fee binding target may be a separate project-owned component.

PlatformFeePolicyV1.description: The exact assessment pair and accounting mode are intent-bound. The server recomputes all derived fee values.

PlatformAdmissionPolicyV3_1_0.description: Immutable launch-admission policy shared by profiles 3.1.0 and 3.2.0. Exactly seven objective code-and-role rules are hard blockers. Proxy, delegatecall, mint, tax, pause, liquidity and return-delta surfaces require evidence but do not categorically block deployment. Admission is not an audit or a safety, honeypot, liquidity, tradeability, or fee-behavior guarantee.

PlatformAdmissionPolicyV3_0_0.description: Immutable legacy profile-3.0.0 policy retained only so byte-identical existing requests remain readable and retryable. New packs use profile 3.2.0.

PlatformAdmissionPolicyV1.description: Revision-3 admission policy. Profile version selects one exact immutable policy; clients cannot combine a profile version with the other version's rule set.

DirectNativeHookPermissionPolicyV1.description: All fourteen Uniswap v4 permission bits are supported. Return-delta permissions require their corresponding action permission and the hook address low bits must match the declaration.

oneOf.description: Native ETH value is carried only by the exact Router transaction returned after conformance and simulation for separate wallet review. signatureRequired is false because there is no separate pre-Router funding signature; the wallet still explicitly signs the Router transaction.
No launch funding is transferred by the graph. The final Router transaction still requires explicit wallet review and signing even when value is zero.

productionLaunchAuthorized.description: The V3 general profile is production authorized; runtime trust roots, role-aware admission and Router simulation still fail closed independently.

platformFeeProofPolicy.description: Revision 2 compatibility field. New revision 3 requests use platformAdmissionPolicy.

DirectNativeHookGraphProfileV1.description: Production-authorized revision 3 direct-graph profile. Metadata-bound profile 3.2.0 is current; exact 3.1.0 and 3.0.0 requests remain readable and retryable under their original policies. Exact source and compiler reconstruction, role-aware static admission and Router simulation remain mandatory. Neither result is an audit or a safety, honeypot, liquidity, tradeability, or fee-behavior guarantee.

fee.description: Static fee 0..999999 or the Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee sentinel 0x800000.

DirectNativePoolKeyV1.description: Currencies are distinct and sorted by numeric address. The hook address low bits must equal the declared 14-bit permission mask.

targetId.description: Must equal targetRoles.platformFeeBindingTargetId and name an exact graph target.

DirectNativePlatformFeeBindingV1.description: The server recomputes project and effective values for both directions and rejects any mismatch.

LaunchSeededLiquidityAssessmentV1.description: Declares the exact seeded-liquidity checks still required. It is not evidence that they ran or passed.

HookInventoryLiquidityAssessmentV1.description: Declares the exact custom-accounting checks still required. It is not evidence that they ran or passed.

DirectNativeLiquidityModelIntentV1.description: Hash-bound liquidity intent. External concentrated liquidity remains liquidity_required; seeded and hook-inventory models require exact later assessment and cannot self-declare a pass.

DirectNativeLiquidityIntentProjectionV3.description: Server readback of the declared liquidity model. This is not current liquidity or tradeability evidence.

liquidityModel.description: Current CLI 3.3.2 output always includes this exact hash-bound intent. Omission is accepted only for byte-compatible earlier V3 requests and resolves to legacy external concentrated liquidity without inventing a binding claim.

FundingSignaturePatchDescriptorV1.description: Derived unsigned initializer binding. Offsets include the four-byte selector, are distinct, satisfy (offset-4)%32=0, remain in bounds and identify all-zero ABI words. The create request still contains no signature bytes.

AbiArgumentPathV2.description: Zero-based ABI argument path. The first index selects a top-level initializer input. Later indices descend only static tuple components or fixed-array elements; dynamic parents are invalid.

FundingAuthorizationPatchDescriptorV2.description: Current CLI-derived unsigned initializer binding. The four paths are distinct and resolve through static ABI containers to zero bytes32 nonce, bytes32 r, bytes32 s and uint8 v leaves. The CLI derives calldata offsets from the exact compiled ABI and proves canonical decode and re-encode; an applicant cannot submit offsets. The backend inserts only the derived nonce and verified wallet signature after the unsigned launch intent is bound. The create request contains no signature bytes.

FundingAuthorizationPatchDescriptor.description: CLI 3.3.2 uses authorization patch V2. V1 remains accepted only for existing exact request compatibility.

Eip3009FundingAuthorizationDescriptorV1.description: Unsigned descriptor only. It requires validAfter < now < validBefore. It contains the nonce derived from the pre-signature funding intent but no signature, v, r or s value. Authorization patch V2 derives that intent while nonce, r, s and v leaves are zero, then inserts the derived nonce and verified signature into the final initializer calldata.

CustomGraphBundleV3.description: The Router primitive supports 2 through 16 targets, while this V3 profile requires 3 through 16 because the project-owned token, project-owned hook and initializer roles are distinct. The hook may use any valid Uniswap v4 permission mask; return-delta permissions require their corresponding action permission.

DirectNativePermitWindowV1.description: Exact Router permit validity window. deadline must be after validAfter and no more than 3600 seconds later.

DirectNativeExactSourceVerificationBundl.description: Revision 3 exact-source bundle. Every compilation unit uses solc 0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a. Decoded Standard JSON is limited to 5,242,880 bytes per unit and in aggregate, with at most 2,048 sources per unit. Revision 2 compatibility requests retain their prior compiler contract.

oneOf.description: Canonical NFC ABI argument name, already trimmed, without controls or recognizable secret material, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

ProjectTokenMetadataStaticBindingV1.description: A unique static constructor or initializer source is matched exactly when available. Otherwise both ABI leaves are null and arbitrary token architectures remain packageable.

ProjectTokenMetadataBindingV1.description: Derived nonblocking token declaration binding. Static extraction is enforced only when one exact ABI argument is unambiguous; final name and symbol still require onchain readback.

description.description: Canonical NFC public text, already trimmed, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes.

uri.description: Canonical public HTTPS URI without query or fragment, canonical ipfs CID URI, or canonical ar transaction URI. HTTPS should expose browser-readable CORS bytes so wallet review can verify this object's digest, length, media type and dimensions; a failed remote check renders a placeholder and never mutates or signs the launch.

links.description: Unique entries in strict UTF-8 order by kind, NUL, then canonical public HTTPS URI.

name.description: Canonical NFC token name, already trimmed, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.

symbol.description: Canonical NFC token symbol without whitespace, at most 16 UTF-8 bytes.

ProjectMetadataV1.description: Canonical display metadata. Its domain-framed projectMetadataHash is included in the bound graphBundleHash, launch intent, prepared artifact, wallet review and onchain launch identity.

oneOf.description: Bounded onchain readback, at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes.
Bounded onchain readback, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

FinalizedCustomLaunchTokenMetadataReadba.description: Finality-scoped onchain name and symbol comparison. Unavailable is explicit and never converted into a matching claim.

resourceId.description: Public resource correlation only. Consumers key canonical identity by routerLaunchId.

graphBundleHash.description: Metadata-bound graph hash used by the Router launch identity.

FinalizedCustomLaunchMetadataListV1.description: Finalized-only public backend page. It has no embedded LKG fallback; downstream services must label their own bounded fallback freshness.

projectMetadataHash.description: sha256 of the UTF-8 domain programmable.project-metadata.v1, one NUL byte, and canonical projectMetadata JSON.

fundingIntentHash.description: Pre-signature domain-separated funding intent. It is not a sha256: label. Authorization patch V2 derives it from the unsigned launch intent whose nonce, r, s and v leaves are zero; it does not include the final graph containing the patched nonce or signature.

CustomLaunchCreateRequestV3.description: Closed unsigned V3 create envelope for a project-owned token, project-owned hook and complete 3-16 target launch graph. The request contains no wallet signature or transaction approval, and additional properties are rejected.

Eip3009FundingTypedDataV1.description: Exact eth_signTypedData_v4 payload. The connected wallet, chain, domain, to, value, nonce and validity window must be checked client-side before the explicit signature action.

path.description: Single-resource website wallet-admin handoff returned by the backend. It is not an API-key CLI operation.

signature.description: Canonical 65-byte lower-case r || s || v serialization. The website submits it only after an explicit wallet signature action.

FundingAuthorizationSubmissionV1.description: Website wallet-admin handoff schema. It is exposed only on the website-token operation and never on an API-key CLI operation.

ExactWalletTransactionV3.description: Exact Router transaction for explicit wallet review and send. It is a second wallet action only for EIP-3009 funding; for native-value or no-funding mode it is the sole wallet action. It is never auto-signed or auto-broadcast.

unboundGraphBundleHash.description: Raw sha256 of canonical graphBundle JSON before project metadata binding.

PreparedLaunchArtifactV3.description: Prepared Router artifact with the exact-source verification bundle required by the V3 admission contract. Current profile 3.2 artifacts contain the complete non-null metadata triple; exact legacy artifacts omit all three metadata fields.

FinalizedCheckpointV1.description: Two-provider finalized checkpoint quorum. It may coexist with submitted evidence when the agreed checkpoint still trails the launch block.

CustomLaunchOnchainEvidenceV3.description: Canonical Router event evidence. finalizedCheckpoint is optional for legacy compatibility and may be present in either submitted or finalized evidence.

ExactSimulationEvidenceV3.description: Server-authored exact Router simulation evidence pinned to one canonical Mainnet block and timestamp.

FundingBoundaryV3.description: Closed wallet-authority boundary repeated on every V3 output stage. No mode uses an approval transaction or Permit2. Only EIP-3009 mode adds a separate typed-data funding signature; native-value mode carries exact msg.value on the Router transaction and none mode carries no funding. The service never produces a wallet signature or broadcasts the Router transaction.

PlatformAdmissionStatusV1.description: Revision 3 admission classification after the exact-source static baseline found no hard-blocking code and target-role pair. Evidence duties remain bound and visible without becoming routing, fee, source, indexing or feature claims. Router simulation is still required. This is not an audit or a safety, honeypot, liquidity, tradeability, or fee-behavior guarantee.

prefixItems.const: Static indicators do not prove that a contract is safe, non-malicious, or economically solvent.
No static result replaces exact fork simulation of buys, sells, liquidity lifecycle, callbacks, or fee routing.
A no-static-finding result only permits later conformance review; it is never an approval or audit.

StaticBaselineReportV1.description: Deterministic bounded exact-source and runtime indicator report. It is neither approval nor a safety claim.

CustomLaunchRemediationV1.description: Bounded machine-readable project remediation. It never contains credentials, signatures, source excerpts or provider diagnostics.

oneOf.description: Durable exact Router simulation input. No controller-wallet action is exposed before simulation passes.

message.const: Automatic static admission found a blocking target-role condition. Follow the bound remediation before wallet authorization.

oneOf.description: Automatic static admission found a blocking target-role condition. Follow the bound remediation before wallet authorization. This stage never asks the controller wallet to sign or broadcast.

status.description: Durable lifecycle state. action_required carries a deterministic static-baseline report and bound remediation for an exact blocking target-role condition; it is not a wallet action or a request for manual approval. Only awaiting_funding_authorization and authorized expose separate controller-wallet handoffs.

launchProfileVersion.description: Immutable persisted launchProfile.profileVersion. Metadata is required only for 3.2.0; exact 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.1.0 resources retain legacy null metadata semantics.

projectMetadata.description: Hash-bound current-profile metadata. Null only for byte-compatible legacy requests.

walletHandoffUrl.description: HTTPS controller-wallet handoff for the current explicit signing stage. It is absent or null outside a wallet action and never grants signing authority to the API key.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the current wallet handoff, when one exists. Clients must refetch status instead of signing an expired payload.

lifecycleQueue.description: Durable worker scheduling state. It is operational readback, not launch finality or transaction evidence.

CustomLaunchSummaryV3.description: Bounded list projection. Output is always redacted; use the single-resource GET for precise polling and wallet handoff data.
